reviewScope.summary: Independent source-level review of the ACT 18 integration originally committed at a6cb2b8e12cfbd656b49a6fbb1de0b5123bf4469 from production baseline 0bf1c9d68d8a830f00ca76ddc4e19cc4367f7c22, followed by the owner-reported two-file QA and CSS correction at 53869d1092228cf59379e7b80690cd6b43c44913. The latter commit and payload identity b3ae5c213c175bf2f2527f5b85e62a2a03543390 are owner-reported, not independently read from the local Git object database. The 18 new exercises extend the existing four-category Utviklerblikk track; six previous Generelt activities are preserved. The code review identifies no outstanding release-blocking source issue after the narrow correction. Decision PROCEED to native review-evidence consumer validation and the required hosted release gate, not a claim of full release certification, approval to merge, or production smoke verification.
evidence: Reviewed owner-supplied ACT18-a6cb2b8.patch (21 files, +3103/-147) plus complete successor e2e/utviklerblikk-ux.spec.ts and src/styles/microlearning.css source copies; two supplied successor CSS copies are byte-identical (SHA-256 93341399c2b8e5b780ce60ff959371ea8b3d813c0f075f70f54a9ffe140cf2c1). Exact successor two-file Git patch was not supplied; the owner reported +109/-12 and the latest local commit/payload identities.

Original integration uses static typed Scrum, Kanban and Smidig samarbeid modules in an existing static Vite content chunk with narrow schema support for four-option track selections, unused text-match choices and multiline grouped answers. Prior review independently compared all 18 authored answer-key sequences with supplied committed test expectations; no mismatch was found. No new backend/learner persistence was established by source diff.

The shared inspect() helper in the supplied successor E2E source defaults to strict on-screen control top/bottom and hit testing. Its tallGroupedAnswers exception is explicit and used only in the 320x568, 200%-root-text A05 test when a grouped answer exceeds the viewport height; that helper tests scroll-to-both-ends, line bounds and elementFromPoint, not two real pointer activations.

The successor CSS adds two scoped rules, flex-wrap:wrap for .micro--utviklerblikk .micro-options .micro-tap and white-space:nowrap for its small result marker. Inspection of screenshots-qa01, qa01b, qa01c shows the earlier long marker wrap in the 320px 200%-text correct-answer capture and one-line rendering in the final capture; no CSS rule is applied to other track surfaces.

Owner-reported focused results: 3/3 K04/A04/A05 Chromium scenarios at 1280x800, 360x560 and 320x568 with 200%-root-text; a previous CSS variant reproduced two failing scenarios; unchanged Generelt six-activity reachability passed; formatting, lint, typecheck and git diff --check passed; production build and budget check passed (CSS 14,182 B gzip, JS 429,198 B gzip). These commands were not independently executed in this review.

Reviewed the screenshots ZIP with QA01, QA01b and QA01c sets (61 PNGs and three measurements JSON files). Normal 360x560 examples recorded 263–799px route scroll depending on state, and 320x568 root-font 200% examples 2,646–4,860px. The captured Lukk wrapping is an existing visual issue not demonstrated to block operation. These are usability observations, not proof of physical-device or real browser-zoom acceptance.

The ACT 18 candidate still lacks a complete candidate-bound hosted GitHub native gate outcome and production smoke. Prior accepted results and current focused checks are not substitutes for the remaining release authority.

adversarialFindings.description: The original ACT 18 E2E inspect() helper had broadened oversized-control visibility exceptions beyond the intended 200%-text A05 case.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The successor source restores strict default control visibility and limits the tall grouped-answer exception to an explicit opt-in for the enlarged A05 case. Screenshots and a focused reporter pass support the correction.

adversarialFindings.description: Long A05 answer text squeezed the correct-answer marker into narrow columns at phone sizes, making it wrap letter by letter.
adversarialFindings.resolution: A two-rule Utviklerblikk-scoped CSS correction lets long answers wrap their marker below as one line; the final 200%-text captures show the corrected appearance. Unchanged Generelt path was reportedly checked.

adversarialFindings.description: Correct-answer reading paths of roughly 634–790 words have not been timed with learners and may exceed the intended two-to-five-minute experience, particularly for learners reading Bokmål as an additional language.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Do not represent nominal durations as measured. Retain editorial fidelity and address demonstrated pacing problems with subsequent learner observation, not an unbounded pre-release rewrite.

adversarialFindings.description: Large scrolling ranges under simulated 200% root text and known Lukk wrapping are visible. Passing geometry/hit tests demonstrate bounded reachability, not smooth reading or physical-device/browser-zoom certification.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Preserve accurate limitations and do not claim comprehensive visual acceptance. No source-proven new navigation blocker justifies another ACT 18 change cycle at this time.

adversarialFindings.description: Total JS gzip 429,198 B approaches the explicitly expanded 435,000 B ceiling. Build figures and static chunk/offline behavior were reported by the implementing agent, not re-executed here.
adversarialFindings.resolution: A measured 18-activity addition justifies the bounded ceiling increase; retain budget checks and avoid further architecture changes merely to recover speculative headroom.
